official: 寒川町消防団員等公務災害補償条例の一部改正について
session: 令和8年第1回定例会6月会議
name: 葬祭補償に加える額を1万5,000円引き上げ
summary: 現在、葬祭補償は315,000円に補償基礎額の30倍を加えた額です。この議案では、加える額を330,000円に変更します。令和8年4月1日以降に支給理由が生じた葬祭補償に適用します。
changes: 葬祭補償に加える額を315,000円から330,000円に上げる
who: 公務などで亡くなった非常勤消防団員等の葬祭を行う人
why: 非常勤消防団員等に係る損害補償の基準を定める政令の一部改正に伴い、必要な措置を講じるためと、町は説明しています。

en.name: Raises the amount added to funeral compensation by ¥15,000
en.official: Regarding a Partial Amendment to the Samukawa Town Ordinance on Compensation for Public-Service-Related Deaths and Injuries of Fire Brigade Members and Others
en.summary: Currently, funeral compensation is ¥315,000 plus 30 times the compensation base amount. This bill changes the amount added to ¥330,000. It applies to funeral compensation for which the reason for payment arises on or after April 1, 2026.
changes: Raises the amount added to funeral compensation from ¥315,000 to ¥330,000
who: People arranging funerals for part-time fire brigade members and others who died in the course of public duties or similar
en.why: The town says it is taking necessary measures in response to a partial amendment to the Cabinet Order establishing standards for compensation for damages involving part-time fire brigade members and others.
